pages.title: Fluid Pipes
pages.text: Fluid pipes are used to transport liquids (such as water, sewage, etc.) between devices. $(br2)Each pipe node has an internal buffer of 1,000 mB (1B, corresponding to 1 unit in the original work).

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Pipes work similarly to Belts and are a variation of them. $(br)They can transport up to 1,000 mB at a time.$(br)$(#ff0000)Note: The fluid system is currently still under development.$()

pages.title: Switching Modes
pages.text: By default a pipe only does pure transfer: it keeps pushing whatever fluid is already inside forward.$(br2)Right-click a pipe with the $(l:arknights_endfield:tips/control_terminal)Control Terminal$() to cycle Transfer / Extract / Insert — use Extract for the first pipe of a line and Insert for the last one.
